Recon already finds and scores companies well; to help job seekers, add a parallel “Jobs & Roles” layer on top of the same lead engine and voice UX.[1]

## Job-focused search surface

- Add a Jobs tab where users search by role, level, location, and industry, similar to how you already search companies like “Ad agency – Mumbai.”[1]
- For each company Recon surfaces, show a “View open roles” button that pulls roles from their careers page or job boards and lists them under that company entry.

## Candidate pipeline & tracking

- Let users save jobs as leads, with stages like Saved → Applied → Interviewing → Offer, just like Saved Leads for companies.[1]
- Add simple fields per job: salary range, contact person, last follow-up date, and notes from calls/interviews.

## Outreach to hiring managers

- On each company card (e.g., DDB Mudra, White Rivers Media), add a “Find hiring contacts” and “Draft message” button.[1]
- Provide AI-written first outreach, follow-up, and thank-you messages tailored to the company and role, using the existing AI Analysis concept.

## Insights for candidates

- Reuse the “OVERVIEW / INSIGHTS / OUTREACH / HIRING” pattern but from the candidate perspective: culture notes, recent restructuring, new leadership, and whether they are hiring in specific departments.[1]
- Show a simple “fit score” between the candidate’s profile and each role, similar to your current match percentage for companies.

## Voice assistant for job search

- Extend “Start Voice Assistant” so a user can say “Find mid-level copywriter roles in Mumbai agencies hiring right now and save the best 10 to my Jobs list.”[1]
- Allow voice-driven updates: “Move Social Beat copywriter role to Interviewing” or “Remind me to follow up with Ogilvy HR in 3 days.”
